channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Anwar reaffirms Malaysia as reliable sustainable palm oil supplier to India
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim has reaffirmed Malaysia’s commitment to remain a reliable supplier of sustainable palm oil to India.

item.title: Anwar lauds Modi's unwavering support for peace in Gaza, Ukraine
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim today commended his Indian counterpart, Narendra Modi, for India’s firm and unequivocal commitment to supporting peace efforts worldwide, including in the Middle East, particularly in Gaza.

item.title: Nga: Ministry ready to help states regularise places of worship without proper approval
item.description: IPOH: The Housing and Local Government Ministry is ready to assist state governments in ongoing efforts to regularise places of worship that do not have proper approvals, its minister Nga Kor Ming said.

item.title: Early BCG vaccination vital for infants against TB
item.description: JOHOR BARU: A health advocacy group has urged parents to ensure infants receive early vaccination to protect against major diseases, including tuberculosis (TB).

item.title: Thai van driver pleads not guilty to dangerous driving, causing motorcyclist's death
item.description: JITRA: A Thai van driver pleaded not guilty today at the magistrate’s court here to a charge of dangerous driving causing the death of a female motorcyclist last month.

item.title: Malaysia, India to strengthen cooperation in healthcare and traditional medicine
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: Malaysia and India today reaffirmed their partnership in healthcare and traditional medicine, committing to exploring joint health initiatives to address critical medical needs across the region.

item.title: Government mulling licensing to regulate AI applications
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The government is looking to study regulating artificial intelligence (AI) applications through a licensing system to prevent the creation and spread of child sexual abuse materials (CSAM).

item.title: Italy will not join Peace Board
item.description: MILAN: Italy “cannot participate” in the US-proposed Board of Peace as its charter conflicts with Italy’s Constitution, Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said on Saturday, reported Xinhua.

item.title: Fire breaks out at auto parts factory in Petaling Jaya
item.description: PETALING JAYA: Orange flames and thick black smoke billowed into the sky as fire engulfed an automotive spare parts factory in densely populated Petaling Jaya, officials said.

item.title: Modi reaffirms India's commitment to Asean centrality, Indo-Pacific stability
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has reaffirmed New Delhi’s steadfast commitment to the stability of the Indo-Pacific region, with Asean centrality at its core.
